name: @conet.project/chat-sdk
description: Beamio CoNET Chat SDK — gossip messaging in a Web Worker (zero main-thread openpgp/verify) + encrypted fragmented IPFS history. UI-agnostic, reusable across SilentPassUI / bizSite / Alliance / POS.

scripts.test:voice: tsx scripts/testVoiceReorder.ts && tsx scripts/testVoiceEntryPool.ts && tsx scripts/testVoicePeerWait.ts && tsx scripts/testInboundArmor.ts
scripts.test: npm run test:voice && npm run test:local && npm run test:signing && npm run test:history && npm run test:plaincache && npm run test:libraryrow && npm run test:remotecommit && npm run test:restoremerge && npm run test:twotabs && npm run test:batch && npm run test:objectcontent && npm run test:localfirst

sideEffectsNote: The package has no import-time side effects (sideEffects: false). The worker (./worker) starts only when the host calls startChatWorkerEntry(); the host wrapper is src/workers/chatSdkGossip/entry.ts. Do not rely on importing ./worker to start it (R82).
